queries:
SELECT team_id,
       AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / g) AS avg_win_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS record_count,
       AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / g) - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / g) AS a FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id)) AS difference
FROM manager_half
GROUP BY team_id;
SELECT team_id, year, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) AS player_count, MAX(salary) - MIN(salary) AS salary_diff
FROM salary
GROUP BY team_id, year;
